flagged.evidence: The step says that if F' vanishes identically on D, then “f would be locally constant near x, and, since a locally constant map on a connected space is constant by [F4], f would be constant.” [F4] only gives constancy for a map locally constant on the connected space; the proof has established constancy on one neighborhood. Extending that local constancy across X requires the identity theorem for maps in overlapping charts, which is not shown here.
